# From raw files to a paper-scale SCOP workflow

Read H5, 10x three-file, RDS, H5AD, Loom, multimodal, and multi-sample inputs; perform auditable QC and integration; compare annotation choices; select advanced analyses from the biological question; and analyse spatial transcriptomics. Every published analysis PNG is generated by an exported SCOP plotting function on named real data.

[Start the detailed curriculum](start-here.qmd){.btn .btn-primary} [中文教程](zh/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-light}
:::

## What makes this a usable tutorial

Every substantive workflow chapter contains:

- learning outcomes and an explicit input contract;
- exact R calls, key parameters, and object-field requirements;
- real executed values where the backend and design were available;
- SCOP-native plot provenance naming the function, dataset, and checkpoint;
- output/checkpoint requirements and reproducibility evidence;
- failure modes, alternative routes, and a practice task;
- a boundary stating what the result cannot prove.

The site distinguishes **executed evidence**, **version-checked templates**, and **not-executed optional backends**. A polished plot never substitutes for biological replication or a valid study design.

## The curriculum spine

::: {.grid}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 01 · Get data in

Choose the reader for H5, a three-file 10x directory, RDS, H5AD, Loom, text matrices, multimodal data, or multiple samples. The official PBMC 1k H5 is round-tripped through three-file and RDS forms with exact dimensions and UMI counts.

[Detailed input guide →](input-formats.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 02 · Build trustworthy objects

Audit counts and metadata, inspect QC before thresholds, call doublets per library, join Seurat v5 layers, examine cluster stability, estimate dimensions, and preserve checkpoints.

[Detailed single-sample case →](single-cell-case.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 03 · Scale to studies

Keep patient and sample identity, distinguish biological samples from technical sources, integrate only when justified, validate both mixing and biology preservation, and retain sample-level inference.

[Multi-sample and cross-source →](multi-sample.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 04 · Annotate by evidence

Combine marker programmes, contradictory evidence, cluster markers, reference transfer, CellTypist or SingleR, confidence, tissue context, and unresolved labels in a consensus table.

[Annotation choices →](annotation.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 05 · Ask advanced questions

Use pseudobulk, enrichment, composition, trajectory, communication, SCENIC, metabolism, CNV, or Scissor only when their experimental-unit and backend contracts pass.

[Advanced analysis →](advanced.qmd)
:::
:::
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.lesson-card}
### 06 · Add spatial evidence

Audit image and coordinates, run spot QC, find spatially variable features, build spatial graphs, test neighbourhoods, and decide whether deconvolution or integration is supportable.

[Spatial transcriptomics →](spatial-case.qmd)
:::
:::
:::

## A real executed integration result

![SCOP CellDimPlot panels of real pancreatic cells before and after SCT plus Harmony integration.](assets/figures/real-data/cross-source-integration.png){fig-alt="Three SCOP UMAP panels show pancreatic cells before Harmony by source, after Harmony by source, and after Harmony by cell type."}

::: {.scop-native}
**SCOP-native figure provenance:** all three embedding panels were generated by `scop::CellDimPlot()` from the real `panc8_sub` cross-source checkpoint and composed without replacing the SCOP analysis layer.
:::

On `panc8_sub`, the mean fraction of 20-nearest neighbours drawn from another technical source rose from **0.2169 to 0.6765**, while same-known-cell-type neighbourhood preservation rose from **0.9379 to 0.9616**. This supports the SCT + Harmony integration path on this object. The eight source labels are not eight biological replicates.

## The complete paper path

The [paper-scale framework](paper-framework.qmd) connects design, input, per-sample QC, atlas construction, annotation, composition, pseudobulk expression, enrichment, one mechanistic extension, and optional spatial validation to concrete figures, tables, checkpoints, and allowed claims.

The [dataset atlas](datasets.qmd) explains exactly which real object supports each lesson. The [reproducibility chapter](reproducibility.qmd) provides the source checksum, runtime, rebuild command, eleven-figure provenance manifest, and verification gates. The [troubleshooting guide](troubleshooting.qmd) starts from the earliest broken contract rather than hiding a failure downstream.

## Recommended first route

1. [Start here](start-here.qmd) and name your independent experimental unit.
2. Read [core concepts](concepts.qmd) before integration or condition testing.
3. Reproduce one [bundled dataset](datasets.qmd) end-to-end.
4. Replace the teaching object with your data at the input checkpoint.
5. Stop whenever the design, backend, or validation contract fails.

::: {.boundary}
**Evidence boundary.** This site proves executable workflows on the named real datasets and locked runtime. It does not prove that a method is appropriate for every study, turn technical sources into patients, or convert reanalysis of bundled teaching data into a new biological discovery.
:::
